name: Ironman California

build.note: Sacramento build starts the day after IM 70.3 Oregon (2026-07-20).

target_splits.bike: 6:37 (~17mph, flat 2-loop course -- patience is the key)
target_splits.run: 4:45 (walk/run 9 min run / 1 min walk every mile, plus a walk at every aid station)

strategy.bike_target_power_note: TBD pending professional bike fit -- the Oregon target of 145-152w does not apply to Sacramento.

course_notes: Flat, 2-loop bike course -- pacing discipline matters more than raw power. River swim.
climate_notes: October in Sacramento -- heat preparation still relevant, though cooler than a summer race.

nutrition_plan.run_fueling: Gels every 20-25 minutes on the run -- zero run calories was the primary cause of the Oregon run fade.
nutrition_plan.bike_fueling: Full-distance carbohydrate tolerance and fueling execution validated across long rides.

equipment_plan.bike: Quintana Roo Kilo, professional bike fit completed to resolve Oregon's back/foot pain.
equipment_plan.checklist_notes: Use a torque wrench and a structured mechanical checklist before race week.

coaching_themes: Arriving at T2 fueled and mechanically comfortable
prior_race_lessons_carried_forward: Validate bike fit under long-duration load.
Use a torque wrench and structured mechanical checklist.
Track pain and equipment problems as structured events.

week_focus.1: Recovery -- easy aerobic only, no intensity
week_focus.2: First volume step-up -- Sacramento ROUVY sim, long run
week_focus.3: Consistent build -- back to back bikes, swim consistency
week_focus.4: First brick week -- 60 min ride then 20 min run, threshold swim sets
week_focus.5: Outdoor ride + long run -- first 45-50mi outdoor ride, run 10-11mi
week_focus.6: Recovery week -- volume drops 35%, no intensity
week_focus.7: Race-specific intensity -- Thu 3hr outdoor brick + Sat's first 75mi ride (full-IM length), race nutrition practice
week_focus.8: Peak volume week -- biggest week of the build, Thu 45mi brick (moderated) + Sat 90mi peak ride, open-water long swim
week_focus.9: Second peak week -- Sat's 95mi ride is the true peak of the entire build (~5.6hrs), 18mi peak long run
week_focus.10: Step down from peak -- volume drops meaningfully, keep run frequency, absorb the peak block before taper
week_focus.11: Sharpener -- last race-pace efforts, 4x200 swim, 3x8min bike, nothing hard after Wed
week_focus.12: True taper -- volume -60%, bike packed, travel to Sacramento
week_focus.13: Race week -- arrive Sacramento, race Oct 18

week1_special_rule: If current_week == 1, this week (Jul 21-27) is mandatory post-race recovery after Oregon 70.3 on Jul 20. Low or zero TSS is 100% intentional and correct -- never flag as concerning, behind, or at risk. Only encourage rest, recovery, hydration, and booking a bike fit.
